name.description: Name for the extension. Max 63 characters, lowercase letters only, no special characters.

resourceType.description: What kind of resource this is — determines whether versions are Keycloak-version-dependent.

allOf.description: Kind of custom resource an extension holds. `THEME` and `EXTENSION` are tied to a Keycloak major version and use the versioned upload flow; `PASSWORD_BLACKLIST` and `WELL_KNOWN` are version-independent and use the standalone upload flow.
allOf.title: ResourceType
